items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: I even recorded with Lester, made some beautiful recordings with him.

ctx.x: Yes. In fact, after I came back East later on, I even recorded with Lester, made some beautiful recordings with him. I met him. And Lester had a brother who played drums. His name was Lee, Lee Young. I met him.
